quantile_rule.js_low_bits: 1st percentile of posterior JS divergence over calibration same-length pairs
quantile_rule.edit_high_rate: 75th percentile of the Levenshtein RATE (distance / prefix length) over the same calibration pairs; a pair qualifies when its distance is at least ceil(rate * t)
quantile_rule.js_control_min_bits: 50th percentile (median) of JS divergence over the same pairs
quantile_rule.js_high_bits: 90th percentile of JS divergence over calibration lure pairs
quantile_rule.edit_low: fixed at 2 a priori; a near-lure differs by at most two symbols
